headline: As of 05:00: the next internal CRM update has passed its security check and is waiting to be run today.
items: The next internal CRM update is approved, packaged, and cleared by the final security check.
The update must start today on the team's machine; a last script review is still pending.
Tech, Product and Data teams filed their daily status for Friday.
Late status reports from the previous day were added to the knowledge base.
Quality review of the update follows after it runs.
